glossary.definition: (A) "Infant" means a child who is less than one year of age.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5103.602 to 5103.6018 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5103.60 - Residential infant care center definitions.

glossary.definition:
(B) "Residential infant care center" means a facility that has as its primary purpose the provision of residential services for infants affected by substance use and the preservation of families through infant diversion practices and programs.
